The proposal concedes this in its own devil's-advocate paragraph (line 299: 'The distilled rule's function class strictly contains R_GD') but leaves P1 as the decisive test anyway. reviews.fatal_defect: No fatal defect in the reject class (no direct-prior match, no fatal leakage, no safety red line). Highest-impact defect: the decisive control is not iso-capacity with the treatment. R_GD is a linear preconditioner W (64x64) plus four scalars (~4e3 parameters, u_i = W e_i, w_i = k_i), while R_theta is a width-256 MLP (~1e5 parameters) that emits u_i and w_i freely; both are trained by KL to the same teacher at equal compute. The primary endpoint F(R_theta) - F(R_GD) >= 0.10 therefore conflates two things the proposal treats as one: 'the teacher's update is not preconditioned GD at this interface' versus 'a nonlinear rule fits the KL target better than a linear one'. A nonlinear-preconditioned GD rule (u_i = f(e_i, k_i), w_i = k_i) would still be gradient-form yet is outside R_GD, so P1 can be won and K1 avoided without any non-GD structure (content-conditional forgetting, w_i != k_i) ever being demonstrated. Compounding this, the label-trained sibling is trained on cross-entropy to labels, not KL to the teacher, so it cannot plausibly tie a KL-distilled rule on a teacher-fidelity metric; the K6 collapse (tie within 0.05) is structurally near-impossible and the 'distilled HOW vs any learned rule' control is inert on the primary endpoint. Section anchors: 'Mechanism and Falsifiable Predictions' (Superset control block; P1; K1; K6), 'Controls, Baselines, and Ablations' (bullets 2-3), and the proposal's own devil's-advocate paragraph ('The distilled rule's function class strictly contains R_GD'). Procedural blocker alongside it: Compute FAIL with no harness code, no pilot image, and the header's evidence bundle (evidence/icl-rule-distillation-port/bundle.json) absent from the repository (no evidence/ directory exists).

The proposal is unusually well-specified for a pre-code contract: the two-pass write/read structure makes causality a code property, the wave-3 repair (matched gold-plus-shuffled placebo, TR-fidelity gate, teacher-fidelity endpoint, per-base gate, downstream-attention read-path ablation) genuinely closes the wave-2 identification holes, the falsifier set is complete, licences and revisions are enumerated, and the negative-result value is real. The state read at the query is therefore not the clock-decayed state the estimand assumes but an attention-refreshed one, and the number of rehearsal opportunities scales with token count, i.e. with fertility, with the opposite sign to the clock effect. P3 (pass), K2 (kill) and K2b (reclassify) are all ambiguous on the primary Qwen3.5 subject; the only clean arm is rwkv7, which has a different gate object and tokenizer and is used only as a sign check. reviews.fatal_defect: The wave-3 primary counterfactual is mis-specified in a way that can kill or pass the alignment line for the wrong reason. T* is defined as argmin_T xi_T on development languages (Mechanism section: "T* = argmin_T xi_T on development languages, frozen before test"), and K2a kills the line when "xi_T* <= 0.2 * xi_hs". But xi_T = Delta_ind - Delta_T is an excess over the target's own gap, so an aggregation whose target is itself cross-lingually weaker (a larger Delta_T) shrinks xi without improving the indexer's absolute cross-script needle recall. The retrieval-head-weighted target is the obvious case: retrieval heads are literal copy heads (2404.15574, cited in the proposal), so R_T(CX) for that target is expected to be poor, Delta_T large, and xi small. Under the registered rule this target could be selected as T*, K2a would fire ("the gap is a DSA-recipe artifact that QSA-style or retrieval-head targets remove for free"), and the line would be published as a recipe finding even though the indexer's CX recall never improved. Symmetrically, the primary endpoint rho_x = [xi_T* - xi_T*+x]/xi_T* is a ratio to a denominator that the T* selection rule has already minimised, so the 60 percent recovery bar is easier or harder depending on how bad T* is cross-lingually rather than on what L_x does. Neither wave-2 judge raised this; both accepted "strongest label-free target" as the fix without noticing that "strongest" is operationalised on the excess statistic rather than on absolute selection quality.

reviews.verdict: Wave 3 is a real repair, not a relabel: the pure-write object W(a|c) = S(c+a) - S_{v=0}(c,a) removes the wave-2 prefix-identity shortcut by algebra, the same-prefix negatives and the matched A2/A3/A5 arms give phase 1 a genuinely identifying design, the phase-0 kills are now within-model with matched perturbations and fireable rank-capped transport, and the Olmo pair is honestly demoted to a descriptive reference. My independent total is 63/100 (question fit 7, primary sources 7, novelty 5, mechanism 6, controls 7, evaluation 7, feasibility 6, reproducibility 5, safety 8, adversarial review 5); the caps for incomplete novelty coverage (74: the wave-3 object was never searched and blind discrimination against 2608.27115/WriteSAE is pending), missing executable pilot (79: execution disabled, no fla image, no manifest, no evidence bundle directory) and missing provider-distinct signed review (89) all apply but none binds below 63. The decision-bearing failures are methodological and evidentiary, not conceptual: phase 1 lacks any instrument-sensitivity gate, so a 57M model trained on 200M tokens may leave every arm at floor on surface-disjoint cross-lingual keys and burn 12 GPU-h without a readable A1 - A2; the decisive A2 control may be numerically near-identical to the treatment for short spans with no pre-registered W-vs-P distinctness check; the believability bar for an architecture-causal label (per-arm tuning, scaling ladder, asymptotic budgets) is unmet and the proposal's own prose concedes the label. Recommendation: do not run any GPU stage until the phase-1 floor gate and the W-vs-P distinctness floor are added to the YAML and the CPU doctor exists; then the 3.8 GPU-h phase-0 screen is worth running on its own merits because all three of its negative branches are informative. Compared with the wave-2 judges (59/57 on the wave-2 draft; the gauntlet JSONL records 62 for the same wave, a bookkeeping mismatch to reconcile), my gains are concentrated in controls/identification and primary-source evidence, consistent with the wave-3 changes; novelty and adversarial-review quality are unchanged because no new search or provider-distinct review occurred. Calibration: NOT_CALIBRATED.

reviews.verdict: Calibration: NOT_CALIBRATED. Independent total 63/100; caps recorded but not binding below 63: missing executable pilot (79), incomplete novelty coverage / pending blind discrimination vs 2608.27115 (74), no provider-distinct signed review (89); a falsifier exists at every phase, so the 59 cap does not apply.
